lanterns.graph: k = floor((LocalPosition.X - CandleX0_cm) / CandlePitch_cm + 0.5); OpacityMask = (k < LitCount) ? 1 : 0; Emissive = FlameColour * EmissiveStrength * flicker(Time + k)
lanterns.note: same master and graph as the G116 lesson candles; paper is opaque, so OpacityMask switches the glow to the unlit paper colour instead of hiding it (static switch UnlitShowsBase=1)
lanterns.sockets: SOCKET_Lamp_k: warm point light while k < LitCount; light them all when the choir closes
